about: Walls UI fixture (Product item AU). Every value is made up: hunter2, tacocat and 4417 are placeholders, and the fake store is not a real shop. WallsUITests reads these rows so no session types secret-shaped phrases by hand. Surfaces: askBar (Ask Tess, Write), notesPage (Notes writing line), siriAddTask (CreateTaskIntent.add in a unit test; Siri can't be driven from a UI test), paste (Kitchen, Paste a recipe). The key rows have phrase null and build KEY: the test joins buildParts in code at run time, so the key prefix is never one literal in this file. lineMatch is exact or prefix; expectLine null means no line check. passesOnMaster and masterEvidence were read on origin/master fbede70 (Oct 16, 2026). pending names the owner of a known fail; the test wraps those rows in XCTExpectFailure. Spec: docs/research/walls-ui-test-spec.md.
